d: John A. Kantara proves that lies have always been part of warfare, exploring the role of propaganda in spreading one's truth.
For thousands of years, wars and conflicts have been fought under the guise of religion. Rudolph Herzog discusses how faith has brewed conflict.
In the battle between truth and lies, money plays a decisive role. Nothing seems to be safe from the power of money and the influence of those who possess it.
Scandals have accompanied human history since ancient times. Dive into the history of scandals and witness how they have changed over time.
The Kennedy assassination, Pizzagate, Coronavirus - conspiracy theories are booming, thanks in part to the internet. But they are not a modern phenomenon.
History has produced a steady stream of 'influencers', from apostles to ad men and doctors to despots. They are proof of just how fluid and fragile the truth can be.
John A. Kantara proves that lies have always been part of warfare, exploring the role of propaganda in spreading one's truth.
